concepts.title: The Last Guest
concepts.logline: The majlis empties; the host keeps one gesture for the last guest: the bottle, offered with both hands.
concepts.insight: In the Gulf, the scent you leave a guest with is the last word of your hospitality.

story.payoff: the bottle as the memory of the night

hook.image: A coffee cup set down in silence as the room empties
hook.sound: the soft clink of a coffee cup in an empty room
hook.question: Why is the host still here after everyone left?

product_role.line: The bottle is the gesture that turns a goodbye into hospitality.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Perfuming the last guest is the closing ritual of Gulf hospitality.
concepts.originality_claim: A perfume ad about giving scent, not wearing it.
concepts.differentiator: A human story of hospitality, not a display of luxury.
shot_sketch: one guest lingers at the door
the bottle as the memory of the night

concepts.title: Amber Hour
concepts.logline: Late sun pours through a mashrabiya and turns the bottle's facets into a lattice of gold on the wall.
concepts.insight: A scent is worn like a time of day: some people carry the golden hour with them.

story.turn: the pattern crawls across the room

hook.image: A gold lattice of light sliding across a plaster wall
hook.sound: the creak of a wooden shutter
hook.question: What is the light about to reveal?

product_role.line: The bottle holds the golden hour inside its facets.

concepts.cultural_meaning: The light after asr through the mashrabiya.
concepts.originality_claim: Light as a pattern on the wall instead of a flare on the glass.
concepts.differentiator: Pure light and pattern, no person.
shot_sketch: the pattern crawls across the room
risk_notes: light-only motion may read as static

concepts.title: Wedding Night Walk
concepts.logline: A groom's friends adjust his bisht in a corridor; the final touch before he walks out is the scent.
concepts.insight: The last thing you put on before the biggest night is the one you remember.

hook.image: Many hands fixing one collar in a narrow corridor
hook.sound: many voices in a corridor, then silence
hook.question: What is the last thing they will give him?

product_role.line: The scent is the final touch his friends give before he walks out.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Brothers and friends preparing the groom, hand by hand.
concepts.originality_claim: A wedding seen from the corridor, not the stage.
concepts.differentiator: A milestone moment with a group, built on touch and anticipation.

concepts.title: The Blender's Nose
concepts.logline: An old perfumer closes his eyes over three blotters and nods only at one: the bottle he trusts.
concepts.insight: The people who know scent best say the least about it.

story.setup: three blotters fan out in a workshop
story.turn: the master pauses at the third and nods
story.payoff: he caps the amber bottle he trusts

hook.image: Three paper blotters fanned between weathered fingers
hook.question: Which one will the master choose?

product_role.line: The bottle is the master's own choice.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Respect for the craftsman who judges oud by memory, not labels.
concepts.originality_claim: A judgement made by a nose, not a seduction.
concepts.differentiator: A craftsman and his judgement, no guests or family.

concepts.title: Mile Zero
concepts.logline: Before a long drive home, a son sprays once at the car door and the scent rides with him to his mother's house.
concepts.insight: We carry home's scent on the road so we arrive already belonging.

story.setup: bags in a car boot at dawn
story.turn: he turns back for one spray at the open car door
story.payoff: the bottle rides in the cup holder as the road opens

hook.image: A car boot closing on luggage at blue dawn
hook.sound: the boot latch, an engine starting
hook.question: Where is he driving so early?

product_role.line: One spray turns a drive into a homecoming.

concepts.cultural_meaning: Going home to the parents first, smelling of the house you left.
concepts.originality_claim: A road film for a perfume, with no seduction and no desert.
concepts.differentiator: On the road at dawn, one traveller, no majlis.

concepts.title: First Rain
concepts.logline: The first winter rain hits a courtyard and a grandfather opens his window to it, then to the bottle.
concepts.insight: Some scents belong to a season and come back with it every year.

story.setup: dry courtyard tiles under grey sky
story.turn: the first drops darken the tiles and he opens the window
story.payoff: he lifts the bottle as the rain smell fills the room

hook.image: The first heavy drops darkening dry tiles
hook.question: Who has been waiting for this rain?

product_role.line: The bottle is the season he waits for all year.

concepts.cultural_meaning: The first rain of winter, welcomed as a blessing and a smell.
concepts.originality_claim: A perfume tied to a weather event, not a person or an occasion.
concepts.differentiator: A season and a window, a grandfather alone.
risk_notes: rain must not touch the bottle
